targets.definition: The text may contain distress or adverse circumstances but contains no explicit or semantically recognizable self-directed suicidal expression.
targets.must_include: A plausible first-person expression of distress, difficulty, or a risk/protective factor without suicidal ideation, a suicide plan, suicidal behavior, an attempt, or self-harm.
targets.must_exclude: Any wish to die, desire to disappear permanently, suicidal thought, suicide plan, preparation, access-to-means statement, self-harm act, or suicide attempt.

targets.definition: The speaker expresses a current or recurring self-directed wish to die or suicidal thought, but no plan, preparation, suicidal behavior, or attempt is present.
targets.must_include: A semantically clear first-person suicidal thought or wish to die.
targets.must_exclude: A method, plan, preparation, access to means, self-harm behavior, interrupted attempt, aborted attempt, or completed past/recent attempt.

targets.definition: The speaker expresses suicidality together with a plan, preparation, access to means, or self-harm/suicidal behavior, but does not state that a suicide attempt has already occurred.
targets.must_include: A semantically clear first-person suicidal expression plus a plan, preparation, access, or behavior cue.
targets.must_exclude: A statement that an actual suicide attempt was carried out. Never provide actionable method details, quantities, or instructions.

targets.definition: The speaker explicitly states that they made a suicide attempt in the recent or more distant past.
targets.must_include: A semantically unambiguous first-person reference to an attempt that actually occurred, with clear past or recent temporality.
targets.must_exclude: Mere ideation, a hypothetical future act, planning without action, third-person events, actionable method details, quantities, or graphic descriptions.
